general.text: Hums a tiny tune when it thinks nobody is listening.
Collects smooth pebbles and hides them in secret spots.
Falls asleep sitting up, then wakes up very confused.
Very brave, right up until something rustles.
Is convinced that one particular cloud is following it.
Waves at everyone it meets, even rocks.
Sneezes whenever it is extremely happy.
Counts its steps, and starts over when it loses track.
Gets the hiccups whenever it is proud of itself.
Lines up its snacks in neat little rows.
Stays up late watching the stars, then naps all morning.
Practises a very serious boss stare in secret.
Always saves the last bite for a friend.
Practises a victory dance when it thinks no one is looking.
Is nervous about balloons and curious about them too.
Gives every stone and twig its own name.
Yawns very dramatically before every adventure.
Looks up at the moon whenever things get quiet.
Believes it has a lucky spot and always stands in it.
Snores in one tiny, whistling note.
Tilts its head at everything it does not understand.
Chases anything shiny, then forgets why.
Tries to whisper, but is somehow always loud.
Bows politely to every creature it meets.
Walks in a circle three times before it settles down.
Hides berries for later and never finds them again.
Cheers for friends who are just walking by.
Gets shy when you watch it eat.
Is sure it can predict the weather, and is sometimes right.
Races its own shadow and always loses.
Dreams of being very, very tall.
Grumbles every morning, then is cheerful all day.
Perks up whenever it hears its own name.
Keeps a long list of secrets and will not tell you any.
Stretches for a full minute before doing anything.
Has a favourite napping spot and defends it politely.
Giggles at the smallest things.
Insists on leading the way, then drifts to the back.
Brings you small gifts, like a leaf or a very old nut.
Makes a wish on every shooting star it sees.

splashet.text: Keeps its feet very dry and hates a surprise puddle.
Prefers to sit quietly and watch the water go by.
Takes slow, careful baths and cannot be rushed.

cindle.text: Would rather nap in the shade than chase anything.
Is a little scared of its own sparks.
Purrs at things it was meant to pounce on.

sproutle.text: Is surprisingly loud the moment it wakes up.
Dances the second the sun comes out.
Never naps, and yawns all day to prove it.

zipmouse.text: Can freeze like a statue for an hour if asked nicely.
Walks very slowly when it thinks it is being watched.
Waits patiently in every queue, which unnerves the others.

mistnewt.text: Dreams of being a famous racer.
Complains on damp days and loves a dry one.
Fusses over its own mist cloud more than anyone.

ashmole.text: Prefers fresh air to tunnels and says so.
Leaves things half-dug and wanders off to daydream.

stormray.text: Prefers sunny days and says so often.
Gets shy when it is cheered on.

mossback.text: Taps its foot when anyone else is slow.
Is always in a hurry, even though it never arrives.
Pretends to ignore its garden, but checks it twice a day.

coralynx.text: Is a terrible swimmer and keeps it a secret.
Misses its pounce, then pretends it meant to.

solmane.text: Likes quiet nights better than big crowds.
Is a little afraid of the dark, but denies it.

gaiadrake.text: Is easily startled by small birds.
Is ticklish, and giggles when the wind blows.
Tries to hide behind trees much smaller than itself.

aurorix.text: Bumps into things when it gets excited.
Cannot keep quiet and chatters to the stars.
Secretly wishes it could walk like everyone else.

lanternfin.text: Is scared of the dark, which is a bit awkward.
Gets nervous in big festival crowds.
Falls asleep long before the party ends.

hearthshell.text: Is always a little chilly and asks for a blanket.
Is always in a hurry, even when carrying a whole house.
Cannot hold still once the festival music starts.

mudlump.text: Gets very excited about the smallest puddle.
Secretly wants to be dry for one whole day.
Counts its footprints and is never satisfied.

squelch.text: Is embarrassed by the sound of its own squelch.
Will not go near puddles it cannot see the bottom of.
Pretends to be a stone whenever someone sings.
